title: 饮酒·其五
author: 陶渊明
intro: A man who has left official life lives quietly among ordinary people. Picking chrysanthemums by the fence, he looks up and the mountain is simply there — and he finds there is nothing more to say.
analysis: 陶渊明辞官回到乡下，过着种地、喝酒、写诗的生活。这首诗开头说：我把房子盖在人来人往的地方，却听不到车马的喧闹声。为什么？因为“心远地自偏”——心离名利远了，住在哪里都觉得安静。这句话讲的是一个道理：安静不在于地方，而在于心。接下来是最有名的两句：在东边的篱笆下采菊花，悠闲地一抬头，南山就出现在眼前。“见”是无意中看到，不是特意去“望”，所以显得特别自然。傍晚山里的雾气很美，鸟儿结伴飞回山林。最后说：这里面有人生真正的意义，想要说出来，却已经忘了该怎么说。真正的体会是说不出来的。这首诗把景物和道理融合在一起，语言平淡，味道却很深，是中国田园诗的代表作。
analysisEn: Tao Yuanming gave up his government post and went back to the countryside to farm, drink and write. The poem opens with a puzzle: I built my hut where people live, yet I hear no noise of carts and horses. How? “When the heart is far away, the place becomes remote by itself.” Quiet is not about where you live but about your mind — once you stop chasing fame and money, even a busy place feels peaceful. Then come the two most famous lines: picking chrysanthemums under the eastern fence, I calmly see the Southern Mountain. The verb is 见 (to see, to catch sight of), not 望 (to gaze at): he isn’t looking for the mountain, it just comes into view. That casual moment is the whole point. In the evening light the mountain air is lovely, and birds fly home together. The ending says there is a true meaning in all this — but when he tries to put it into words, the words are already gone. Some things can only be felt. Plain on the surface, rich underneath, this is the best-known poem of Chinese “fields and gardens” poetry.
background: Tao Yuanming (365?–427) served in minor official posts but disliked the politics; at about 41 he resigned for good and lived as a farmer. This is the fifth of twenty poems titled “Drinking Wine”, written in his years of retirement.
pronunciation: “悠然见南山”的“见”读 jiàn（看见），不读 xiàn。“飞鸟相与还”的“还”读 huán（回来），不读 hái；“何能尔”的“尔”读 ěr（这样）。
version: 采用统编语文教材八年级上册文本，全诗十句，此处完整收录，按一联一行排版。“采菊”旧本作“採菊”；“欲辨已忘言”一作“欲辩已忘言”。宋代苏轼指出有版本作“悠然望南山”，并认为“见”字更好，今通行本均作“见”。

lines.zh: 结庐在人境，而无车马喧。
lines.rhythm: 结庐/在人境，而无/车马喧
lines.py: jié lú zài rén jìng, ér wú chē mǎ xuān
lines.lit: I build a hut in the world of people, yet there is no noise of carts and horses.
lines.en: I built my hut where people live, yet no carts or horses clatter by.

lines.zh: 问君何能尔？心远地自偏。
lines.rhythm: 问君/何能尔？心远/地自偏
lines.py: wèn jūn hé néng ěr, xīn yuǎn dì zì piān
lines.lit: You ask how this can be? The heart is far, so the place becomes remote by itself.
lines.en: How can that be, you ask? When the heart is far away, any place grows quiet.

lines.zh: 采菊东篱下，悠然见南山。
lines.rhythm: 采菊/东篱下，悠然/见南山
lines.py: cǎi jú dōng lí xià, yōu rán jiàn nán shān
lines.lit: Picking chrysanthemums under the eastern fence, at ease I see the Southern Mountain.
lines.en: Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence, I look up — and there is the Southern Mountain.

lines.zh: 山气日夕佳，飞鸟相与还。
lines.rhythm: 山气/日夕佳，飞鸟/相与还
lines.py: shān qì rì xī jiā, fēi niǎo xiāng yǔ huán
lines.lit: The mountain air is lovely at dusk; flying birds return together.
lines.en: At dusk the mountain mist is lovely, and birds fly home together.
lines.tts: 山气日夕佳，飞鸟相与环。

lines.zh: 此中有真意，欲辨已忘言。
lines.rhythm: 此中/有真意，欲辨/已忘言
lines.py: cǐ zhōng yǒu zhēn yì, yù biàn yǐ wàng yán
lines.lit: In this there is a true meaning; wanting to explain it, I have already forgotten the words.
lines.en: There is a true meaning in all this — but when I try to say it, the words are gone.

words.note: 庐：简陋的房屋，今天还有成语“三顾茅庐”。

words.en: the world of people; where people live

words.note: 古义，对别人的尊称。今天书面语偶尔用。
古义，相当于“这样”。今天成语“不过尔尔”还有这个意思。
今天书面语仍用，如“悠然自得”。
无意中看到，和有意去“望”不同。
古汉语，现代汉语说“傍晚”。
古今都读 huán 时意思是“回来”，如“还乡”“归还”。

imagery.name: 菊
imagery.zh: 采菊是隐居生活中最平常的动作，菊花也象征诗人不随波逐流、清高淡泊的品格。
imagery.en: Picking chrysanthemums is an everyday act of his quiet life; the flower also stands for his pure, unworldly character.

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 南山不是特意去看的，而是一抬头就出现，写出人和自然之间悠闲自在的相遇。
imagery.en: The Southern Mountain isn’t sought out — it simply appears as he looks up: an easy, unplanned meeting between man and nature.

imagery.name: 鸟
imagery.zh: 傍晚结伴回巢的飞鸟，暗示诗人自己也回到了真正属于他的地方。
imagery.en: Birds flying home together at dusk hint that the poet, too, has come home to where he belongs.
